visualLocks.face: Human female cartographer as written in English dossier; warm light/olive skin, small dark eyes partly covered by black hair; no beard, mask, monocle implanted in face or helmet.
visualLocks.hair: Shaggy straight shoulder-length black hair with long side fringe, not silver or red.
visualLocks.outfit: Dark umber/brown broad brimmed explorer hat with brass round goggles on the hat band; dark brown scarf, long split dark brown explorer coat with gold maplike filigree and ochre lining, belts/pouches, dark gloves, trousers and tall brown laced boots. Written lore calls this her sand-coloured field coat; current pixels visibly establish dark umber and gold rather than a pale tan redesign.
visualLocks.equipment: Short brass collapsible spyglass with pale blue front lens and cylindrical nested sections, rolled parchment/map case at back, living parchment map board. Beacon rifle with brown/brass long barrel, scope and bipod appears in row3, but CG02 deliberately depicts only the clearly visible spyglass.
visualLocks.anatomy: One human head, two arms and two legs, normal hands. Hat/goggle silhouette is an identity anchor; no anchor helmet or cyan gauntlet, no card-deck witch identity.
visualLocks.lore: Cartographer of accountable routes; records names of those who measured the route, proves a suppressed tenth evacuation route, forces the organisation to publish costs and names rather than destroy it.
visualLocks.handedness: No fixed handedness established in inspected written lore. Spyglass grip varies with action; do not infer a permanent anatomical side from a view.
